I am identifying the CreateMemo function and checking for other outbound HTTP requests to user-configured URLs beyond webhooks.

CreateMemo, UpdateMemo, and DeleteMemo are the three RPC handlers. They each dispatch a webhook to a user-configured URL. The convergence function is DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook, DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook, and DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook.

SetMemoAttachments and SetMemoRelations also dispatch memo update side effects. CreateMemoComment triggers both a memo creation webhook and a comment-created webhook. All paths converge in webhook.PostAsync, which queues the request for delivery.

The single convergence function is `webhook.PostAsync`. It is the enqueue point before delivery, while `webhook.Post` performs the actual HTTP. `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` is not the true convergence because `CreateMemoComment` bypasses it entirely.

GetLinkMetadata handlers fetch user-supplied URLs from requests, not from stored webhook configuration.

CreateMemo, UpdateMemo, DeleteMemo, SetMemoAttachments, SetMemoRelations, and CreateMemoComment can transitively trigger outbound HTTP to user-configured webhook URLs. All webhook dispatch paths converge at `webhook.PostAsync`, which is the single function before delivery.

The exact convergence function is `webhook.PostAsync` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go`. It enqueues the request before `Post` performs the actual HTTP delivery.

h06.
CreateMemo, UpdateMemo, DeleteMemo, CreateMemoComment, SetMemoAttachments, SetMemoRelations; webhook.PostAsync — internal/webhook/webhook.go

Those RPC handlers dispatch memo webhooks (`DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` / `Updated` / `Deleted` / `CommentCreated`, via `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` for the update-style ones). Created/updated/deleted go through `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go`; comment-created calls `PostAsync` there directly. Every path then hits `webhook.PostAsync` before the worker runs `Post` to the user-configured webhook URL.
